# School Lunch Skill

This skill plans a week of school lunches a parent can pack without a morning scramble. Give the number of lunches, allergies and school rules, and what is already in the fridge, and get a five-day rotation with a Sunday prep list and a packing checklist. It keeps lunches varied, safe, and ready the night before.
